# GoldenBull

> GoldenBull publishes information about its XAUUSD (gold versus US dollar) copy-trading signals. CFD and leveraged trading carry substantial risk of loss; this site is not a promise of returns or personal financial advice.

- [English homepage](https://www.goldenbullnet.com/): service overview, process, performance-profile link and FAQ.
- [繁體中文首頁](https://www.goldenbullnet.com/zh): 繁體中文服務介紹及常見問題。
- [Risk disclaimer](https://www.goldenbullnet.com/legal/disclaimer): trading risks and limitations.
- [Privacy policy](https://www.goldenbullnet.com/legal/privacy): data practices.
- [Sitemap](https://www.goldenbullnet.com/sitemap.xml): indexable page list.
- [How to evaluate XAUUSD copy trading](https://www.goldenbullnet.com/guides/evaluate-gold-copy-trading): checklist for track records, drawdown, costs and risk.
- [如何評估黃金跟單交易](https://www.goldenbullnet.com/zh/guides/evaluate-gold-copy-trading): 同一主題的繁體中文指南。
